subject: reasoning
question: ETL is related to CVN in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. Similarly, BOI is related to DMG. Following the same logic, JUN is related to which of the following?
solution: Here, we use the table given below: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/582da6920e49f1a53bcf4b54532b42c06428d6b353f7cee7962cd5a7111151a4.png] ​ **Logic: '2' is added to the positional value of the consonants and '2' is subtracted from the positional value of the vowels.** ETL is related to CVN →
